items.quote: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons
items.claim: Coats of fine linen were made for Aaron and his sons

items.quote: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen
items.claim: A mitre, bonnets, and breeches of fine linen were made

items.quote: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework
items.claim: A girdle of fine twined linen with blue, purple, and scarlet needlework was made
The LORD commanded Moses regarding the garments
